title: feat(core, metadata, objectql, metadata-protocol)!: picklist, mapping, dataset, API and function names are held per namespace (ADR-0150 child B)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg3Q9GGj4YD1Kqoi6WF8xMrm)_
epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbqzUZJRphdYbBQ16b

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：picklist、mapping、dataset、API 和引擎 function 的名字，从「整个部署只能一个包持有」改成「每个命名空间一个包」。两个不同命名空间的包可以各自发同名项，各用各的；同命名空间的共有者、没有命名空间的包、内置名仍然拒绝。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D2/D9，史诗 #31527 子卡 B 的选项表族。各类型的按包读取已经分别落地（#32070、#32071、#32072、#32073、#32069），这里打开开关。
- 新的拒绝：没带包的元数据服务读和删，遇到两个包都持有的名字时答 409；扩展两个命名空间都持有的列表被拒；一次安装、升级、热重载或启动后单项注册，如果会让已装好的字段或扩展变成歧义、或让一个字段的写入方指向不同的列表，会在注册前被拒（席位裁决 A 6811306558、R2 6812862622），不会等到下次重启才失败；引擎按名取 function 遇到两个命名空间都持有时答 409。
- 第二轮（审查 6812847136 FAIL 之后）：重判挪进 registry，所有到达路径共用一处；仓库对 picklist/mapping/dataset 的 (a)–(f) 六处行为变化都列在下表并给出 Clause-② 归类。
- 第三轮（审查 6815437823 FAIL、裁定 R3 之后）：租户层写入的列表挂在某个包下也照样重判（第 20 行）；runtime 重新绑定时不再因为两个包同名的 function 被 409 卡住（第 19 行，全仓只有这一个生产调用方）；热重载被拒时连对象也不导入（第 18 行）。
- 风险与回滚：第一方调用方 0，dogfood 全量见下方。两个持有者时，字段不再有选项、值会被拒，启动时会告警点名；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 里的 `judgePicklistArrival`，再看 `plugin.ts` 安装门和热重载，最后看下方两张 FROM → TO 表。
- 需要你做的：无。#32214 已合入本分支；等 #31696 PR-3 合入后再合一次 main、重跑重叠套件，由专题席位安排落地。

Fixes #31700

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — a read or removal of the metadata service naming no package, of a picklist, mapping or dataset name two packages hold, answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both, where it answered or removed the item registered last; a `picklistExtensions` entry extending a list two namespaces hold is refused at install, and refuses the cold boot, naming both; an install, upgrade, hot reload or late item registration whose lists, extensions or field redeclarations would leave a picklist reference already installed with no one list, or with writers reaching different lists, is refused before anything of it registers; the store keeps one slot per `(package, name)` for picklist, mapping and dataset (moves (a)–(f) below); the engine's bare function read of a name two namespaces hold is refused naming both; and a publish's probe of a widget whose dataset one package holds outside the publishing package's declared closure warns `widget_not_probed` where it probed the widget. The install side widens: two packages of two namespaces may each declare one such name. Every moved answer is in the table below and in the changeset.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #32522

**Narrowing: yes** — first-party callers: **0**. No example app holds a picklist, mapping, dataset, API or function name in two packages: the cold-boot seal, which warned on any such pair before this change, warns on none for these types in the showcase, crm and multi-package boots (dogfood battery, below).

### The store's moves for `picklist`, `mapping`, `dataset` (R2-B)

`PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` puts the three types under the rule `api`, `agent`, `skill`, `action`, `email_template` and `permission` already follow. The live-set pins iterate `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`, so each runs for the three types; each move was ablated for those three alone (record: `/mnt/project-files/epic-31527/card-31700/round2-ablations.md`).

## What changes

- **The switch** (`@objectstack/core`): `picklist`, `mapping`, `dataset`, `api` and `function` join `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`. `function` is the one member that is no metadata type, so the two metadata-type pins (the slotted superset, the exact qualifier's 501) exempt it by name.
- **The store** (`@objectstack/metadata`): `picklist`, `mapping`, `dataset` join `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`; removal by slot is #32198's generic mechanism. `listForPackageScopedIndex` documents its two-holder branch (F3): a package-less row of a name two packages hold fills the environment's slot, as the store's write rule puts it.
- **One picklist re-judge** (`@objectstack/objectql`, rulings A and R2-A): `SchemaRegistry.judgePicklistArrival` judges an arrival with everything registered, over one pending view, before any of it registers: the arrival's own references (from the package writing them) and extensions (caller-less), the installed references and extensions it would break, and every field whose writers would reach different lists. The plugin seals it at `kernel:ready`; the install door (`refusePicklistArrival`), `registerApp` (`admitPicklistArrival`), the item seams and hot reload all ask it, and a judged arrival's per-item seams do not judge again (`registeringPicklistArrival`). `findPicklistReferencesBrokenBy` is gone.
- **The bare engine function read** (R2-C): `resolveFunction` / `resolveFunctionEntry` refuse a name two namespaces' packages hold through core's `resolvePackageScopedHolders`, naming both. Its one production caller, the runtime re-bind's `releaseMovedFunctions`, reads the owner's own entry for such a name (`@objectstack/runtime`, R3-B).
- **Provenance is no shortcut** (R3-A): `registerItem`'s picklist re-judge judges a tenant-authored list under a package as any list of it. Swept: the one-holder item seam, the install door, `registerApp` and hot reload had no such shortcut and are now pinned for it; `registerObject`'s seam keeps excluding a tenant-authored object layer, which writes no package's reference (`picklistReferrerOf`).
- **A refused hot reload ingests nothing** (R3-C): `refreshReloadedPackages` answers `'refused'` and the payload's objects are not ingested.
- **The boot audit** (F2): `SchemaRegistry.findDisagreeingPicklistReferences` names a field whose packaged referrers each resolve to a different list; the boot warns and continues (ruling N2's line).
- **The refusal sentence** of `describeUnresolvedPicklistReferences` keeps "no loaded package declares" only when no line carries a refusal; a refused name now reads "resolves to no one list" with a remedy for both kinds.
- **The build probe** (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`): `publishedItemReader` reads a widget's dataset from the publishing package, so each namespace's publish probes its own `qa_ds`; `widget_not_probed`'s fix text follows the refusal's reason.
- **Docs in code**: `bare-name-one-holder.ts` records the picklist family's narrowing, the readers, the API path rule and the owner-less platform function (card note 6777569899).

## Why

ADR-0150 D2/D9, epic #31527 child B. Every reader of these five types already answers by `(package, name)`; until this switch a second namespace's package still had to rename. Step 0 measured the remaining work (`/mnt/project-files/epic-31527/card-31700/step0.md`); the seat ruled the clause lines (6810963021) and the install-order finding (A, 6811306558).

## Acceptance notes
